import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request


BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"


def request(path):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BASE_URL + path, timeout=2) as resp:
            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            return resp.status, json.loads(body)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        body = exc.read().decode("utf-8")
        return exc.code, json.loads(body)


def wait_for_server(timeout=5):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            status, _ = request("/health")
            if status == 200:
                return True
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(0.2)
    return False


def main():
    print("Chaos experiment: dependency outage with controlled blast radius (local only)")
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.pop("INVENTORY_MODE", None)

    server = subprocess.Popen(
        ["python3", "app.py"],
        env=env,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
    )

    try:
        if not wait_for_server():
            raise RuntimeError("server failed to start")

        steady_health = request("/health")
        steady_inventory = request("/inventory")

        print("Steady state:")
        print(steady_health)
        print(steady_inventory)

        print("Injecting failure: INVENTORY_MODE=down")
        os.environ["INVENTORY_MODE"] = "down"

        failed = subprocess.Popen(
            ["python3", "app.py"],
            env={**os.environ},
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True,
        )
        failed.terminate()
        failed.wait(timeout=2)

        server.terminate()
        server.wait(timeout=2)

        degraded_server = subprocess.Popen(
            ["python3", "app.py"],
            env={**env, "INVENTORY_MODE": "down"},
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True,
        )

        try:
            if not wait_for_server():
                raise RuntimeError("degraded server failed to start")

            degraded_health = request("/health")
            degraded_inventory = request("/inventory")

            print("During failure:")
            print(degraded_health)
            print(degraded_inventory)

            rollback_start = time.time()
            degraded_server.terminate()
            degraded_server.wait(timeout=2)

            restored_server = subprocess.Popen(
                ["python3", "app.py"],
                env=env,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True,
            )
            try:
                if not wait_for_server():
                    raise RuntimeError("restored server failed to start")
                rollback_seconds = round(time.time() - rollback_start, 2)
                restored_health = request("/health")
                restored_inventory = request("/inventory")

                print("After rollback:")
                print(restored_health)
                print(restored_inventory)
                print(f"Rollback seconds: {rollback_seconds}")

                if steady_health[0] == 200 and degraded_health[0] == 200 and degraded_inventory[0] == 503 and restored_inventory[0] == 200 and rollback_seconds < 30:
                    print("RESULT: experiment passed")
                else:
                    print("RESULT: experiment failed")
            finally:
                restored_server.terminate()
                restored_server.wait(timeout=2)
        finally:
            if degraded_server.poll() is None:
                degraded_server.terminate()
                degraded_server.wait(timeout=2)
    finally:
        if server.poll() is None:
            server.terminate()
            server.wait(timeout=2)
        os.environ.pop("INVENTORY_MODE", None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            return resp.status, json.loads(body)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
